title: Side-Scan Sonar Interpretation
content: Side-scan sonar imagery represents acoustic backscatter from the seafloor.
Target interpretation should consider target shape, acoustic intensity, surrounding seabed context and acoustic shadow together.
A bright acoustic return may indicate a strong reflector, but brightness alone does not establish object identity.
Sonar interpretation should distinguish observed evidence from model prediction.
Low-quality, noisy or incomplete sonar imagery should reduce confidence in automated interpretation.
